Pet Food Bank

Charlotte, United States
Checked 2026-08-14

The Humane Society of Charlotte provides free dog and cat food to Mecklenburg County residents facing challenges feeding their pets. The program offers temporary support for up to six months to help keep pets in their homes.

  • Food
CostFree with eligibility.

The pet food assistance program provides dog and cat food at no cost to eligible residents.

AccessOnline or phone application
DirectionsOpen listing
Hours, location & verification
Address
1348 Parker Drive, Charlotte, NC 28208

Check before you go. Must live in Mecklenburg County, NC and own the pets. Standard assistance lasts up to 6 months. Appointments are required for pickup, and delivery options are available.

Pradhan Mantri Garib Kalyan Anna Yojana (PMGKAY)

India
Checked 2026-08-14

The Pradhan Mantri Garib Kalyan Anna Yojana (PMGKAY) provides free food grains to India's poorest households. It serves Antyodaya Anna Yojana (AAY) and Priority Households (PHH) beneficiaries across the country.

  • Food
CostFree with eligibility.

The program provides food grains free of cost to eligible beneficiaries.

AccessMonthly ration distribution
Open listing
Hours, location & verification
Coverage
Nationwide program covering all of India

Check before you go. Available to identified Antyodaya Anna Yojana (AAY) and Priority Households (PHH) beneficiaries through Fair Price Shops.

Official sourceShow on the globe

International Emergency Services

Global
Checked 2026-08-14

The Salvation Army's International Emergency Services (IES) provides critical relief, including food, water, and emergency shelter, to communities affected by disasters and conflict worldwide. The program supports local territories in disaster preparedness and response to meet immediate needs and build resilience.

  • Food
  • Shelter
  • Water
CostFree.

The services are provided at no cost to individuals affected by disasters and conflict.

AccessEmergency response deployment
Open listing
Hours, location & verification
Coverage
Global disaster response network

Check before you go. Services are deployed in response to disasters and conflicts globally, providing immediate relief and long-term recovery support.

The Shower of Hope

Los Angeles, United States
Checked 2026-08-14

The Shower of Hope provides mobile showers, meals, and clothing to unhoused individuals across Los Angeles. The program operates at various locations throughout the week to restore dignity and respect.

Social relief of distress

South Africa
Checked 2026-08-14

The Social Relief of Distress provides temporary assistance to individuals and families facing dire material needs who are unable to meet their most basic needs. It offers food parcels, vouchers, or cash to those experiencing emergencies, lacking income, or awaiting other grants.

  • Food
CostFree resource finder.

The service is provided for free.

AccessApply at SASSA office or online
Open listing
Hours, location & verification
Coverage
Nationwide service covering all of South Africa

Check before you go. Temporary assistance usually for up to three months, which may be extended for another three months. Requires proof of dire material need or emergency.

Official sourceShow on the globe

United States
Checked 2026-08-14

WIC provides healthy foods, personalized nutrition education, breastfeeding support, and referrals to other services. It serves women who are currently pregnant, recently pregnant, or breastfeeding, and babies and kids under 5.

The program provides everyday groceries and other services at no cost to you.

Free school meals

England, United Kingdom
Checked 2026-08-14

The service provides free school meals at no cost to eligible children.

Hours, location & verification
Coverage
Nationwide online service covering all of England

Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program (SNAP)

United States
Checked 2026-08-14

SNAP provides food benefits to low-income families to supplement their grocery budget so they can afford nutritious food. This directory connects individuals to their local state agency to apply for benefits.

  • Food
CostFree resource finder.

The program provides food benefits at no cost to eligible low-income households.

AccessOfficial online locator
Open listing
Hours, location & verification
Coverage
Nationwide online directory covering all 50 states, the District of Columbia, Guam, Hawaii, Puerto Rico and the U.S. Virgin Islands

Check before you go. Eligibility is based on income and resources, and requirements vary by state. Applicants must contact their local SNAP office to apply.

Warm Welcome Spaces

United Kingdom
Checked 2026-08-14

The Warm Welcome Campaign is a network of over 6,000 community spaces across the UK providing free, warm, and welcoming environments. It aims to tackle poverty and isolation by offering places for people to connect, make friends, and stay warm.

The community spaces are completely free to access and use for everyone.
